title: DecisionRail initial production-grade vertical
subtitle: Public recruiter-inspectable repository | deterministic local proof | no deployment or commercial claim
author: Development Studio BUILDER

sections.title: Outcome
sections.subtitle: A real evidence-to-human-decision product vertical, not a generic site

items.claim: DecisionRail implements one complete synthetic evidence-to-release workflow with explicit human authority and no external mutation.
items.evidence: Next.js workspace, five versioned sandbox APIs, five authoritative data contracts, 12 evidence-evaluating detector modules, 24 fixtures, recovery, distinct-human approval, and accepted synthetic handoff.

items.claim: The source repository was public before cloning and the build started from a clean default branch.
items.evidence: GitHub visibility returned PUBLIC; origin/main base d9128a58fb205587cbab0c25eee91857bdf028e4; clean clone before task branch creation.

items.claim: The last reviewed implementation commit is public in open pull request 1 and its hosted validation executed real steps successfully, but review superseded the green check.
items.evidence: Reviewed commit 9e61a5635cc5bf96ec9c8d4d3fb922c90b0e4353; PR https://github.com/shrishmanglik/decision-rail/pull/1; Actions run 30867222677 passed before independent review reproduced a forged handoff. The next corrective head remains pending publication.

items.claim: Customer demand, buyer commitment, commercial outcomes, provider schema, auth, deployment, and revenue remain unknown.
items.evidence: No customer, payment, provider, or deployment action occurred; UI and README preserve these claim boundaries.

sections.title: Exact controls
sections.subtitle: The adjacent check failed before the detector was repaired

items.claim: The pre-fix implementation falsely passed every known-bad fixture and the acceptance test failed nonzero.
items.evidence: npm run test:controls exit 1; 12 failed and 13 passed of 25. Exact receipt: docs/evidence/NEGATIVE-BEFORE.md.

items.claim: The repaired control suite passed twice with exact counts.
items.evidence: Two named npm run test:controls executions each exited 0 with 26/26 tests.
npm run test:mutation exited 0 with 12/12 evaluator-disable, 12/12 missing-module, and 12/12 wrong-issue-code mutations causing the intended acceptance failure.

items.claim: Two complete accepted runs are byte-stable.
items.evidence: Repeatability test compares the complete normalized receipt digest from two runs and passed.

sections.title: Local build and operator proof
sections.subtitle: Source, browser, accessibility, security, recovery, and dependency gates

items.claim: The complete deterministic suite is green.
items.evidence: npm run test: 7 files, 83/83 tests passed; typecheck and lint each exited 0.

items.claim: The production bundle builds on Next.js 16.2.12.
items.evidence: npm run build exited 0; 11/11 pages generated and five versioned APIs plus the combined workspace API compiled.

items.claim: The primary journey works on desktop and mobile Chromium.
items.evidence: npm run test:e2e exited 0 with 4/4 tests: desktop immutable-approval, role-substitution, five-API and typed-error journeys plus desktop/mobile primary UI.

items.claim: Automated WCAG A/AA proof passes after fixing two observed source defects.
items.evidence: Initial run rejected the progress role and mobile scroll focus; repaired rerun passed desktop and mobile 2/2.

items.claim: The proposed persistence contract enables and forces RLS on every table, normalizes same-workspace evidence, and separates builder from approver and operator.
items.evidence: 9/9 tables covered; npm run test:security passed 13/13, including nonrecursive policy structure, derived handoff lineage, and null-safe application-parity constraints. Migration was not applied to a provider.

items.claim: The production dependency graph has zero known npm audit findings.
items.evidence: Initial three inherited highs were remediated with narrow PostCSS and Sharp overrides; final npm run audit:prod exited 0 with zero vulnerabilities.

sections.title: Publication and evidence boundary
sections.subtitle: Public product proof without employer material or fabricated traction

items.claim: The public repository contains no employer-source locator or private authority-root path.
items.evidence: Known-positive boundary search matched DecisionRail; forbidden employer/path scan returned no matches.

items.claim: The secret scan detector works and found no candidate secret in project source.
items.evidence: In-memory private-key marker matched the pattern; bounded repository scan returned no matches.

items.claim: The original authority-root path and bespoke task registration were stale or absent.
items.evidence: Founder corrected the migrated Tier 1 root; feature-build resolved from the canonical schedule; missing product-specific registration is retained as a gap.

items.claim: Merge and deployment remain blocked pending fresh independent approval of the corrective head.
items.evidence: Distinct reviews returned REVISE at 83e41f7b, 5f70bb4c, 9e61a563, 7bb6ea3b, and 01003964. Founder authority permits merge and deployment only after the next corrected immutable head receives APPROVE.
Corrective source, evidence, documentation, local gates, prior REVISE trace, and open PR are recorded; hosted corrective validation is pending push.
